title: Backup history with problems
expect: Scope line names the Pixel and the photo count.
Needs You groups problems by cause: 3 Live Photos, 1 incomplete, 1 original not available; each with sample thumbnails and at most one action.
Then photos by day of their latest change (Today, Yesterday, dates). Tiles are unmarked when in the Pixel's Photos; arrow while sending, clock while saving to Photos, exclamation when it needs you.

actions.result: The same library viewer opens at this photo within the history collection. Information shows capture date, the two backup facts and recorded times, at most one action, and secondary file metadata. An unavailable local asset retains the fallback detail.

actions.action: Tap Try Again on a cause
actions.result: Those photos are sent again and the page reloads.
